programme.title: Mr. D

programme.title: Mr. D

programme.title: Mr. D
programme.desc: Gerry’s been given another coaching assignment, but this time he’s helping Ricki prepare for a fencing tournament, and he couldn’t be less interested. programme.title: Mr. D

programme.title: Louise Zylstra
programme.desc: News - Louise Zylstra was a professional golfer when she was diagnosed with multiple sclerosis, and she responded the only way she knew how: by pushing harder. She trained for hours a day trying to overpower MS, only to drive her body into severe inflammation and neurological symptoms that left her barely able to walk. In this episode, Mathew Embry speaks with Louise about searching for answers beyond her initial prognosis. She shares how she pursued treatments overseas and how that decision changed the direction of her journey. Louise also talks about continuing to explore lifestyle, diet, and supportive therapies as she works to improve her health. Her story will resonate with anyone facing a life changing diagnosis who refuses to quit.

programme.title: Louise Zylstra
programme.desc: News - Louise Zylstra was a professional golfer when she was diagnosed with multiple sclerosis, and she responded the only way she knew how: by pushing harder. She trained for hours a day trying to overpower MS, only to drive her body into severe inflammation and neurological symptoms that left her barely able to walk. In this episode, Mathew Embry speaks with Louise about searching for answers beyond her initial prognosis. She shares how she pursued treatments overseas and how that decision changed the direction of her journey. Louise also talks about continuing to explore lifestyle, diet, and supportive therapies as she works to improve her health. Her story will resonate with anyone facing a life changing diagnosis who refuses to quit.

Louise also talks about continuing to explore lifestyle, diet, and supportive therapies as she works to improve her health. Her story will resonate with anyone facing a life changing diagnosis who refuses to quit.

programme.title: Bill Code
programme.desc: News - In this episode of Hope & Health, Mathew Embry speaks with retired anesthesiologist Bill Code about living with multiple sclerosis for nearly three decades. Diagnosed in 1996, Bill shares how his medical background and personal experience shaped his long-term approach to managing MS. The conversation explores hyperbaric oxygen therapy, omega-3 supplementation, the microvascular theory of MS, and the role of blood flow and cellular energy in neurological health. Bill also reflects on discipline, daily habits, and why many of the strategies he uses extend beyond MS to broader brain and recovery science.
